name: Saci
description: A one-legged black or dark-skinned boy from Brazilian folklore who wears a magical red cap, smokes a pipe, and travels in whirlwinds, playing pranks but rarely causing serious harm. October 31 is officially Saci Day in Brazil.

aliases.name: Saci-pererê
aliases.meaning: the canonical one-legged Black trickster form

aliases.name: Çaci
aliases.meaning: from Tupinambá 'çaci' meaning 'sick eye' or 'evil eye'

origin: Found across Brazil; particularly strongly attested in the Southeast (São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro), the South (Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul) and the Centre-West, with regional variants throughout the country.
